verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents selecting a specific process version by integer number (docs-11). `init` writes skill files into the project, previewable with `--dry-run`, and the docs say those files can be committed to share the setup with the team (docs-8, docs-9, selfeval-2). Installs are shown pinned to `ultrametric@0.4.1` (docs-6, selfeval-1). Together these give a lead real control over when changes land, but there is no lockfile and no documented guarantee against hosted updates. Missing for 10: a lockfile or org-wide version pin, documentation that unpinned hosted guides won't change silently, a changelog or update-notification workflow, and hands-on corroboration of version pinning for hosted processes.
